sections.heading: Jyotiraditya Scindia — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Jyotiraditya Scindia was born on 1 January 1971 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Madhavrao Scindia. He is a sibling of Chitrangada Singh.
His listed education includes Harvard University, Stanford University, The Doon School and Stanford Graduate School of Business.

sections.heading: Jyotiraditya Scindia — Career and Professional Work
paras: Jyotiraditya Scindia works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Member of the 15th Lok Sabha, Minister of Civil Aviation (2021–present) and Minister of Steel (2022–present). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2014, World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2013 and India Economic Conclave 2022.

sections.heading: Jyotiraditya Scindia — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Priyadarshini Raje Scindia.
He is a parent to Ananya Raje Scindia and Mahanaryaman Scindia.
He is associated with Jai Vilas Mahal as a place of residence.
